query: We need to buy 300 numbers across the US and Canada through the eSIM Plus partner API and report the results. Write the ordering and polling code.
expected_behavior: Quotes the draft, submits with an Idempotency-Key, then polls to a terminal status
Treats partial success as normal and reports per-slot failures
assertions: Sends an Idempotency-Key header on POST /phone-numbers/bulk and reuses the same key on retry
Respects both caps: 1..100 lines, 1..100 per line, sum of quantity <= 500, and splits 300 across country/type lines of at most 100
Polls GET /phone-numbers/bulk/{orderId} with backoff until status is completed, completed_with_errors or failed (or finishedAt is non-null)
Reads whole-order counters from data (succeeded/failed/pending) instead of summing items[]
Notes that a 202 is not a purchase or affordability guarantee
